Definition
1. ch4:4.4\group ch04-poisson-newtonian-potential Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0064 A function on $D$ is uniformly $\alpha $-Hölder continuous if \begin{equation} \tag {4.4} [f]_{\alpha ;D}=\sup _{x\neq y\in D} \frac{|f(x)-f(y)|}{|x-y|^\alpha }<\infty . \end{equation} It is locally Hölder continuous if this holds on every compact subset.
